# What blitz-format and blitz-tidy share: a lossless tokenizer, the keyword table, the configuration files and a unified diff.
project(tools)
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} STATIC)
init_project(${PROJECT_NAME})
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME blitz_tools)

target_sources(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
	"source/tokens.hpp"
	"source/tokens.cpp"
	"source/keywords.hpp"
	"source/keywords.cpp"
	"source/config.hpp"
	"source/config.cpp"
	"source/diff.hpp"
	"source/diff.cpp"
	"source/files.hpp"
	"source/files.cpp"
)

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC
	"${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/source"
)

get_target_property(_SOURCES ${PROJECT_NAME} SOURCES)
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${_SOURCES})
